Won from beating Halloween 2019.|Former Inventory Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Won from beating Halloween 2019.|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Slasher''', formerly known as the '''Shredder''', is a short-range ground [[Towers|tower]] that could have been unlocked by triumphing [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It was most recently obtainable via a gamepass costing {{Robux|499}} until the 19th of November 2025. The '''Slasher''' attacks by slashing and stabbing enemies with its knife. Unlike the [[Gladiator]], which is a multi-hit tower, the '''Slasher''' is a single target tower. However, the '''Slasher''' can deal critical damage for 2x damage every three swings at Level 0, with the multiplier increasing with upgrades. At Level 2, it gains the ability to apply bleed to enemies. Each bleed applied will only deal damage to an enemy once before disappearing, with there also being a 1 second delay between each bleed damage. Additionally, it can only deal damage while bleed is not being applied. This bleed can stack up to 450 times, which will cause a bleed collapse, dealing increased damage to the enemy instantly. Once the bleed collapses, there is a five second cooldown before bleed can be applied again. The damage dealt varies based on an enemy's max health and the '''Slasher's''' base bleed damage, EV (exponential value) and how many bleed stacks are removed at once. Because of this, when the enemy receives bleed damage from the enemy over time, it is calculated as:
\text{(Base Bleed Damage} \times (1^{0.9})) \times (\text{Enemy Max Health}^{\text{EV}})
While bleed is collapsing on an enemy, it is calculated as:
\text{(Base Bleed Damage} \times (450^{0.9})) \times (\text{Enemy Max Health}^{\text{EV}})
Damage from bleed is always rounded up, for both damage over time and from bleed collapse. Additionally, damage from bleed damage will not be displayed as the full damage dealt for the '''Slasher''' unless only one '''Slasher''' was applying bleed. Damage displayed will be based on the number of bleed stacks applied by the selected '''Slasher'''. This damage is not affected by [[Damage Buff]]s. The '''Slasher''' can be considered a mid to late-game tower as its fairly effective during the mid and late game due to its high DPS, and its bleed effect that can affect every enemy, including major bosses. SPR1NGM1L3ST0NEExpired |[[Spooky Crate]] |''Wednesday the 30th'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The [[Slasher]] can be very effective at taking down single high health enemies and chipping bosses, due to its high bleed collapse damage. *The [[Slasher]] can apply bleed to enemies, allowing it to deal even more damage to the enemy. **However, these do not deal any damage while the '''Slasher''' is attacking the enemy unless max stack is reached, where it will explode. **The amount of damage dealt is based on the enemy's max health, meaning that its effectiveness scales with the enemy's health. **Placing down multiple '''Slashers''' can help by making them apply bleed faster, also making it explode faster. ***However, at level 4, the '''Slasher''' can apply maximum bleed very quickly, and due to the long cooldown before being able to apply bleed again, it's more recommended to spread out '''Slashers''' to maximize its high collapse damage. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful, as it allows it to deal more DPS and makes it apply bleed faster. *Stalling towers, such as the [[Cryomancer]] or [[Electroshocker]], can be useful, as it makes enemies stay in the '''Slasher's''' range for longer, allowing for it to deal more DPS and apply more bleed. *Be aware of the '''Slasher's''' short range. Placing this tower at corners of the path is crucial to get the most out of this tower. *The '''Slasher''' has a small placement footprint meaning that it can squeeze in beside other towers quite easily, if space is a problem. ==Trivia== *This is the second melee tower to be added to the game, with the first being the [[Gladiator]]. *The former Level 3 upgrade name "''Swords Dance''" is a reference to the [[bulbapedia:Swords Dance (move)|Pokémon move of the same name]]. *The '''Slasher''' was loosely inspired by the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Knifer|Knifer]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Slasher''' was the first tower to gain [[Stun Immunity]] with upgrades instead of having it from Level 0, the second being the [[Accelerator]]. *The '''Slasher''' (when it was called the '''Shredder''') used to have a ''Knife Throw'' ability before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], which would make the '''Slasher''' throw a piercing knife. **This ability was later given to the [[Assassin]] tower, which coincidentally is also a melee tower. **With the ability, the '''Slasher''' gained a 200% [[Range Buff]], its swingrate was set to 0.7 and the ability cooldown was 25 seconds. ***It was meant to receive 500% more damage, but this was glitched and never occurred. **The ''Knife Throw'' became a passive ability that the '''Slasher''' then gained at Level 2, though that was later removed in the [[v1.37.0|Hexscape Update]]. *During one of the public testing sessions before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Slasher''' was renamed from ''Shredder'' to ''Stabber''. In the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this was changed, and it was instead renamed from ''Shredder'' to ''Slasher''. **Prior to its release, the '''Slasher''' could have been called the ''Chainsawer'' instead of the ''Shredder'', as at the time it was still planned to wield a chainsaw at all levels. ***This makes the '''Slasher''' the tower to receive the most name changes. *The '''Slasher''' went under massive changes before being released. **Its original appearance was different. Instead of having black torso and pants it had light grey torso and grey pants. **It would wield a chainsaw at all levels, instead of only the now removed Level 5 — it would not wield knives at all. **Its firerate would be much faster, likely similar to the firerate of towers like [[Minigunner]]. It would however, likely lose damage because of this. **Instead of throwing knives, it would throw piercing saw glaives. *When an enemy was hit by the '''Slasher's''' knife from its ''Knife Throw'', it would emit blood particles. **However, this did not occur with its normal attack, unlike multiple other melee towers. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' {{Scroll|text= *'''18 October 2019''' -
